alt: A short film with no voice. A flat night sky with soft nebula shapes and twinkling stars. Low on the right, a thin crescent moon lies tilted like a smile. Two small block figures with white eyes, one amber and one light blue, stand on the ground and look up at it, then at each other with happy eyes, and lean toward the moon together. The text stays: if this finds you, look at the moon tonight, it is smiling.
